scope: Controlled inference interventions in existing small numeric trajectory policy; not flagship coding or general intelligence
primary_hypotheses: Compare111vs011: legal-action masking changes goal attainment at fixed trained weights and neural inputs
Compare111vs101: removing state-feature readout changes goal attainment when control masking stays enabled
Compare111vs110: removing previous-action feature readout changes goal attainment when control masking stays enabled
controls: Same tasks, weights, seed, numeric normalization, action budget, environment and independent scorer; only declared factors change
primary_statistics: Per-model-seed exact paired McNemar/binomial test; Holm correction across18predefined comparisons; task-cluster bootstrap95CI of seed-mean paired differences
exploratory_statistics: Factorial interactions and conditional unmasked feature effects; descriptive only, no unadjusted significance claim
failed_case_rule: An executed policy failure is retained and scored as unsuccessful; unexecuted cases are absent, never fabricated
limitations: Legal mask can encode target action
Previous-action feature removal does not remove the entire working-memory module
Verification and goals are fixed controls
Coding components and foundation comparisons untested
